summary: Tested iter-116 admin header restructure (5 dropdown groups + pinned Orders/Chats + search + attention block) and manager role restrictions. Backend attention endpoint (/api/admin/attention): 9/9 pytest cases pass — admin returns all 10 keys as ints, manager/client/anon are blocked (403/401), disabled feature zeros the counter. Frontend desktop: admin-nav renders with 5 group triggers (sales/catalog/clients/marketing/system), hover opens admin-nav-menu-{id} with the exact admin-nav-item-{to} entries from the spec, click navigates to the right tab+sub and closes the menu. Badges rendered on pinned links and groups (admin-orders-link-badge=99+, admin-chats-link-badge=6, sales=2, clients=3, marketing=1). AttentionBlock renders on overview with real counts. Browser back/forward keeps ?tab= in sync. Admin search (admin-search-btn) opens dialog with filterable results; 'возвраты' returns Возвраты + Возвраты и гарантия. Old horizontal TabsList and 'Настроить вкладки' are hidden. Mobile burger reveals admin-mobile-nav with all 5 group headings and pinned links; clicking a mobile item navigates and closes the menu. Manager flow: login lands on /manager, manager-header exposes logo+manager-cabinet-link+ai-assistant-link+manager-profile-link+logout-button only, forbidden testids absent (catalog/cart/orders/garage/bonus/favorites/search/chat-widget), direct URLs /, /catalog, /cart, /orders, /garage, /bonus, /favorites, /news, /contact, /admin, /admin/orders all redirect to /manager (verified with proper waits for the React-Router Navigate), /assistant and /account load normally, no topup-btn on /account for manager, no footer. Client regression (user@demo.com): client header + cart/orders/garage/chat widget intact, no admin-nav leak.

issues: Radix accessibility warning: DialogContent is missing a DialogTitle — add a VisuallyHidden title to CommandDialog for a11y.

action_items: Minor: wrap the admin CommandDialog in a VisuallyHidden <DialogTitle> to silence the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/attention.py reads is_on(feature) at request time but is_on's cache TTL means feature-flag flips take up to 2s to be reflected in counts — acceptable; already covered by frontend 30s polling.

adminNav.js ADMIN_PINNED['chats'] badge sums chats+price_requests+product_requests, but AttentionBlock shows these as three separate rows. OK by spec, just note the pinned badge double-counts versus the overview grid.

AdminNav GroupMenu closes on route change via useEffect([location.pathname, location.search]). When hovering out before clicking an item the menu also closes via onMouseLeave which is good; however for keyboard-only users there is no focus trap / Enter handling — the button toggles open on click but items inside are not reachable without a mouse hover. Minor a11y note.
attention.py chats count: distinct chat_id of unread user messages — will double-count a chat even if admin already saw later message in same chat. Consider using latest message unread flag per chat.
